extracted.intended_audience: macOS UI/UX product designers, freelance designers, and design teams looking for a native design & prototyping tool
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and product-level criteria for producing user interface and product design work using the Sketch macOS app, including design, prototyping, collaboration, and handoff workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design without distractions
rubrics_metrics.description: Focused tools, an intuitive interface, and an infinite Canvas. Zero distractions. We made our macOS editor for you and your ideas. Not for PMs, developers or clients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes a minimal, designer-focused UI and workflow; suitable when you need concentration and a native macOS experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible foundations
rubrics_metrics.description: Powerful stack layouts and nestable frames save you time, without locking you down.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use stack layouts and nested frames to accelerate layout work while retaining flexibility; avoids rigid, prescriptive constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Every point perfect
rubrics_metrics.description: Create anything from icons to entire apps with a vector editor like no other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vector editing capabilities aim to support precision work across scales (icons to full app screens).

rubrics_metrics.name: Zero to done (fast ramp-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: Get started fast with 100s of free templates, Frame presets and component Libraries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides ready-made assets and presets to accelerate initial mockups and reduce setup friction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offline? Any time
rubrics_metrics.description: Disconnect and design without compromises. Work locally, without internet, on your terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports uninterrupted local workflows—important for privacy, travel, or unreliable connectivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work effortlessly (workflow helpers)
rubrics_metrics.description: Easy multi-layer renaming, a Canvas Minimap and Command Bar put your workflow on rails.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Small quality-of-life tools designed to streamline repetitive tasks and navigation in large documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create with focus (or friends)
rubrics_metrics.description: Design in private and by yourself. Or co-edit in real-time. The choice is always yours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports both solo focused work and real-time collaborative editing; choose mode based on context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test your ideas faster (prototyping emphasis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nothing beats trying your ideas out to see if they work. So we made doing that as easy as possible. Create realistic prototypes in no time at all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritizes quick iteration through prototyping rather than extensive specification up front.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ready, set, done (rapid prototype creation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a working prototype in less than 10 clicks. Seriously. We’ve counted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design tool should minimize friction between design and interactive prototype; measure by ease and click-count to prototype.

rubrics_metrics.name: Smart Animate
rubrics_metrics.description: Easily add movement to your UI with full control over easing and timings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Animation controls should be fine-grained (easing/timing) while staying accessible for rapid use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modals and more (overlays)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create modals, alerts, panels and menus in moments with Overlays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prototyping features include overlay patterns to simulate common UI patterns quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diverse interaction types
rubrics_metrics.description: It’s not the only way to interact. You can hover, press, drag and swipe here, too.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prototype interactions should cover common input patterns (hover, press, drag, swipe) to model realistic behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scroll free (scroll areas)
rubrics_metrics.description: Create horizontal, vertical, or multi-directional scroll areas — and combine them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support for nested and directional scrolling is important for realistic app prototypes and complex layouts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Test it anywhere
rubrics_metrics.description: Take your prototypes for a test run on any web browser, iPhone or iPad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prototypes must be portable to common testing environments (browsers and mobile devices) for validation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Take your work further (collaboration focus)
rubrics_metrics.description: When it’s time to team up, our collaboration tools keep your designs at the heart of the process. Whether you’re pairing with a single developer, or part of a growing team.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration features should integrate design into team workflows and reduce handoff friction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Easy sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Share your entire document, or create a Preview to share specific pages and prototypes with password protection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sharing should be granular (document or specific pages) and secure (password-protected previews).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pain-free feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Pin comments on designs, reply in threads, then resolve them when you’re done.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feedback tools should allow contextual comments, threaded discussion, and resolution workflow to close the loop.

rubrics_metrics.name: Space for everyone (shared Workspace)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sync up with a shared Workspace for all your team’s files, libraries and drafts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centralized workspace for team files and libraries supports collaboration and versioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: No shady pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Inviting guest editors who pay for Sketch already won’t cost you extra.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing policy that avoids double-charging teams for invited contributors; transparency in billing is a criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share components
rubrics_metrics.description: Share component libraries across projects and manage who can update them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Component library sharing with permission controls enables consistent design systems and controlled updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free handoff tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Invite developers to inspect files, download assets and export tokens for free.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Developer handoff should provide inspect/download/export capabilities without additional cost to the inviter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection colors (new feature announcement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjust shared colors across your selection, highlight matching layers, and narrow your selection by color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Color selection and management tools should let you act on groups of layers by shared color properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent borders and better controls (new feature announcement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set borders for each side, center dashed borders neatly on corners, and apply advanced border settings to text layers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Border controls should be flexible per-side and handle corner/dash behaviors predictably, including text layer options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corner smoothing, capsules, and more (new feature announcement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fine-tune corner smoothing, keep capsules rounded with the new Max option, and round combined shapes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Corner manipulation should offer precise smoothing and options to preserve rounded/capsule geometries on combined shapes.

rubrics_metrics.name: All-new eyedropper (new feature announcement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pick and apply Color Variables with the eyedropper, use the new loupe label, and resize the loupe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Color sampling tool should support color variables, provide informative loupe labeling, and adjustable loupe size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality-of-life improvements (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: 150+ improvements and fixes — from cleaner image drops on the Canvas to faster fill, border, and shortcut workflows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ongoing incremental improvements across many small workflows that cumulatively improve day-to-day usability.
